messages:
elaine: Heads-up: finalizing tomorrow's "Live Benchmark Brief" (10am PT). Need quick decisions on: reg page A/B, Zoom webinar vs YouTube stream, replay gating, and lead routing to HubSpot. Page: https://rwd.ai/events/benchmark-brief?ref=slack

cass: My vote: Zoom Webinar for attendees + simultaneous unlisted YouTube stream for socials. Zoom for controls/Q&A and attendee metrics; yt for reach.

rick: agree. But if we stream to YT, make sure we disable live chat or moderate it. Also recording source should be Zoom cloud (speaker view) not YT, so we get clean recording for clipping.

sofia: reg page note: let's A/B test two CTAs -> "Save my spot" vs "Get the replay". Use hidden fields for utm_campaign=benchmark-2026 and utm_medium=webinar. Also add an optional checkbox: "Share my use case" (short text) — super helpful for sales.

elaine: perfect. For A/B we'll route half to CTA A and half to CTA B via simple client-side split. cass can you confirm analytics will still capture variant?

cass: yep. We'll add a property `webinar_variant` in the payload. HubSpot mapping will include it.

rick: lead routing: registrants -> create contact + company_size prop; attendees -> set property `webinar_attended=true`; engaged attendees (asked Q or >60% watch) -> assign owner = SDR-queue. Prefer direct webhook into our ingestion lambda (no Zapier).

sofia: I can add `company_size` dropdown and `use_case` short text. Also add an opt-out checkbox for third-party emails to satisfy privacy.

elaine: replay policy: full replay gated to registrants for 7 days. After 7 days, move full replay to unlisted public page. Create a 90s highlight clip for socials to publish within 12 hours.

cass: ops-bot, can we automate: export Zoom cloud recording -> copy to gs://redwood-recordings/benchmark-2026/ -> generate 90s clip job -> notify #content-prod?

ops-bot: Affirmative. Post-record workflow: 1) export speaker-view cloud mp4, 2) copy to gs://redwood-recordings/benchmark-2026/, 3) transcribe and tag as `transcript:auto`, 4) spawn clip task (90s) in #content-prod with edit instructions, 5) set TTL for gated link (7 days) then move to public.

rick: schema for webhook (analytics + hubspot ingest):

```
{
  "email": "...",
  "utm_campaign": "benchmark-2026",
  "utm_medium": "webinar",
  "webinar_variant": "A|B",
  "company_size": "small|mid|large",
  "use_case": "...",
  "attended": true,
  "watch_pct": 78,
  "asked_q": false
}
```

Make sure `email` is required, all other fields optional.

sofia: confirmation emails: immediate reg confirm + calendar add; reminder emails at 24h and 15m. Post-event T+24h: replay link + transcript + slides + CTA "Request a custom benchmark" (link to intake form). Also include short survey with 3 questions.

cass: for analytics, bump event names: `webinar_registered`, `webinar_variant_shown`, `webinar_attended`, `webinar_question`. Send to analytics endpoint + HubSpot ingest.

elaine: approvals: @cass please QA the A/B split and analytics. @rick ensure webhook endpoint deployed to prod before event (if not, fallback to Zapier). @sofia finalize reg fields and confirm privacy text. I44d

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Rehearsal at 4:30pm PT today. Zoom webinar created, panelists invited, cloud recording ON, transcription ON, simultaneous YT stream enabled (unlisted).

rick: I'll be on rehearsal. Also run checklist to verify panelist mics and slide deck timings (aim for 35m talk + 15m Q&A).

sofia: I pushed the reg page with variant code to staging. Will enable A/B at 6pm PT.

cass: Analytics QA pass on staging. Variant tags and utm capture validated.

elaine: Final action list: @sofia -> enable A/B + privacy text (by 6pm); @cass -> analytics QA + event tracking (done); @rick -> webhook deploy or zap fallback (by 7pm); @ops-bot -> run export + clip task post-recording. I'll assemble final copy for confirmation email and post-event flow doc in #marketing-ops.

sofia: noted. Sending final reg preview now.

elaine: thanks team, see you at rehearsal. :rocket:
